major_cooldowns.name: Summon Demonic Tyrant
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it with Call Dreadstalkers freshly summoned, a full Soul Shard bar and two Demonic Cores banked, so it buffs every demon you have out and extends your Dreadstalkers.

major_cooldowns.name: Grimoire: Imp Lord
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown from the opener onward, and take its summon as a free dispel of one harmful effect on you.
major_cooldowns.id_note: CAST id observed in 5/5 sampled parses; choice node with Grimoire: Fel Ravager, so zero casts is normal on that build.

major_cooldowns.name: Grimoire: Fel Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Take it over Imp Lord when the fight wants a second interrupt, send it on cooldown, and use Spell Lock while it is down.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; choice node with Grimoire: Imp Lord.

major_cooldowns.name: Summon Doomguard
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it whenever several enemies are up, remembering it only damages five targets at a time.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; the guide lists it in both single-target and AoE priorities.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Siphon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it with two Wild Imps out once you are down to one Demonic Core or fewer, so both charges it grants land.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; talent, and the guide pre-casts it on the Soul Harvester opener.

major_cooldowns.name: Emberwing Heatwave
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire your on-use trinket while your Demonic Tyrant is active.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket CAST id, observed in 3/5 sampled parses; timing taken from the APL, which holds trinkets for the Summon Demonic Tyrant window. Zero casts is normal on a different trinket.

rule.description: Open Imp Lord into Dreadstalkers before Tyrant
rule.action: Send Grimoire: Imp Lord and Call Dreadstalkers before Summon Demonic Tyrant, then dump your shards into Hand of Gul'dan.

rule.description: Call Dreadstalkers out before Summon Demonic Tyrant
rule.action: Send Call Dreadstalkers just before Summon Demonic Tyrant so the Tyrant extends them and picks up the damage bonus.

rule.description: Summon Demonic Tyrant with a full Soul Shard bar
rule.action: Build your Soul Shard bar up before pressing Summon Demonic Tyrant so you can pour it into Wild Imps under the Tyrant.

rule.description: Hand of Gul'dan inside Dominion of Argus
rule.action: Spend every shard on Hand of Gul'dan while the Argus portal is open, since every second cast summons a demon.

rule.description: Demonbolt on Demonic Core, Shadow Bolt without
rule.action: Turn your Demonic Cores into Demonbolt and save Shadow Bolt for the globals where you have none.

rule.description: Do not overcap Soul Shards with Demonbolt
rule.action: Dump a Hand of Gul'dan first so the shards Demonbolt generates are not wasted.

rule.description: Fire Ruination as soon as it procs
rule.action: Press the Ruination that replaces your Hand of Gul'dan on the next global.

rule.description: Power Siphon at low Demonic Core stacks
rule.action: Hold Power Siphon until your Demonic Core stacks are low so both charges it grants land.
